messages:
laura-billing: Heads up — customer acct_8421 opened a chargeback for invoice INV-2026-03-12 ($120). After the dispute they used a promo code (SPRINGFREE200) which applied credit to the account. Now their API keys are rate-limited and showing a negative balance.

mike-support: Ugh. Do we have logs on when the promo credit was granted vs when the chargeback cleared? Could be a timing/order issue.

alex-cust-success: Customer says they were refunded by their bank on 2026-03-13 and we show a chargeback record at 03:12 UTC. Promo was applied on 03:15 UTC via self-serve promo form.

laura-billing: billing-bot log snippet:
```
billing-bot: CHARGEBACK_CREATED acct_8421 INV-2026-03-12 amount=120 reason=card_dispute ts=2026-03-13T03:12:08Z
billing-bot: PROMO_APPLIED acct_8421 code=SPRINGFREE200 amount=200 ts=2026-03-13T03:15:41Z
billing-bot: ADJUST_BALANCE acct_8421 delta=-120 reason=chargeback_clawback ts=2026-03-13T03:12:10Z
billing-bot: INVOICE_GENERATED acct_8421 INV-2026-03-13-ADJ amount=-80 ts=2026-03-13T03:16:00Z
```

jenna-engineering: That ordering looks suspicious — we clawed back the chargeback at 03:12 but then later applied a promo of +200, leaving -120+200 = +80; then invoice generated as -80 (weird sign). Could be double-adjustment when promo applied after clawback. Need repro steps.

mike-support: Repro steps from support side I tried:
1) create test acct
2) create chargeable invoice and mark chargeback via admin
3) apply promo via promo UI
Observed: promo succeeds but account balance calculation yields a negative outstanding invoice and triggers automatic invoice collection which then flips signs.

jenna-engineering: Can you paste the exact DB update we issue when chargeback occurs? I suspect we deduct credits first then mark ledger entry incorrectly.

laura-billing: SQL (redacted):
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE ledger SET available_credits = available_credits - 120 WHERE acct_id = '8421';
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (acct_id, delta, reason) VALUES ('8421', -120, 'chargeback_clawback');
COMMIT;
```

jenna-engineering: Thanks. When promo applies we do:
```
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (acct_id, delta, reason) VALUES ('8421', 200, 'promo_credit');
UPDATE accounts SET cached_balance = cached_balance + 200 WHERE id='8421';
```
We may be failing to recalc outstanding invoices or reconcile negative invoice rows — invoice generation job then sees a negative outstanding and emits a reversal invoice.

finance_bot: FYI: chargeback triggers freeze on payouts and creates a recovery ledger entry. Manual intervention required to restore credits for disputed customers if promo applied after dispute.

alex-cust-success: Customer is blocked — their app hits 429 with body: {"error":"negative_balance","retry_after":0}. They need immediate temporary unblock or emergency credits while we sort.

mike-support: Can billing-oncall grant an emergency credit to restore service while engineering investigates? We should record as temporary goodwill credit pending reconciliation.

billing-oncall: On it. Granting emergency credit +$150 to acct_8421 and marking ticket TCK-998 as pending reconciliation. Will lock further promo application until we patch.

jenna-engineering: For the fix: we should (a) treat chargeback_clawback as a reversible ledger entry and delay auto-invoice generation until all concurrent promo events within a 10-minute window are reconciled, and (b) ensure invoice_job checks for negative outstanding amounts and converts to adjustment entries instead of creating reversal invoices.

laura-billing: Creating follow-up runbook for support: steps to detect this pattern, grant emergency credit, and escalate to billing-oncall + finance. Will attach reproducer + SQL dumps.

alex-cust-success: Customer confirmed service resumed after emergency credit. Asking for official refund/clarification. I'll draft the outbound note.

mike-support: Punting full patch to eng sprint but leaving hotfix guardrails: block promo-applications if acct has a recent chargeback event within 15 minutes. Jenna can you open eng issue?

jenna-engineering: Opened ENG-1542 with repro, logs, and suggested patch. Marking P0 for this week. Thanks all :thumbsup:

laura-billing: Closing loop here — will follow up with finance for bookkeeping. If anyone needs the DB extract I uploaded to secure drive, DM me.
